purpose: Contract artifact shared by leafmachine3.core.paths.canonical_deployment_key and the Electron single-instance key. Both implementations MUST reproduce every 'canonical' value byte for byte; a disagreement produces a directory/lock mismatch that no later test can catch.
algorithm: canonical = ascii_slug(raw)[:32] + '-' + sha256(raw utf-8 bytes).hexdigest()[:8]; ascii_slug maps ASCII A-Z to lowercase by adding 0x20, keeps ASCII a-z and 0-9, turns EVERYTHING else (every non-ASCII code point included) into '-', collapses runs of '-', then strips leading and trailing '-'. Never casefold(), never NFKC.
notes: raw=null means LM3_DEPLOYMENT_ID is unset, which is the raw literal 'default'.
An empty slug keeps the literal separator, so the canonical value starts with '-'.
rejected_by_env vectors are still canonicalized here; the startup check is separate.
'slug' is the UNTRUNCATED ascii_slug output; the canonical value uses slug[:32].

vectors.name: unset
vectors.note: LM3_DEPLOYMENT_ID unset means the raw literal 'default'. Nothing else.

vectors.name: default
vectors.note: Setting it explicitly is identical to leaving it unset, port included.

vectors.name: gpu0
vectors.note: The documented two-GPU split from section 2.1.

vectors.name: gpu1
vectors.note: Its partner; the two must not collide.

vectors.name: uppercase
vectors.note: ASCII A-Z lowercased by adding 0x20 -- slug matches gpu0, hash does not.

vectors.name: mixed_case_words
vectors.note: Spaces become '-' and runs collapse.

vectors.name: path_separator_posix
vectors.note: A '/' must never reach the filesystem as a path component.

vectors.name: path_separator_windows
vectors.note: A backslash is separator-equivalent on Windows.

vectors.name: dot_dot
vectors.note: Slugs to empty, so the literal formula yields '-<hash8>'.

vectors.name: traversal
vectors.note: Traversal is neutralized by the slug and pinned by the hash.

vectors.name: leading_trailing_separators
vectors.note: Leading/trailing '-' are stripped after collapsing.

vectors.name: colon_and_pipe
vectors.note: Every other ASCII punctuation becomes '-'.

vectors.name: unicode_sharp_s
vectors.note: casefold('ß') == 'ss' but toLowerCase is 'ß'; every non-ASCII byte becomes '-'.

vectors.name: unicode_sharp_s_word
vectors.note: The exact case that rules casefold() out for cross-language use.

vectors.name: unicode_cjk
vectors.note: CJK is non-ASCII, so the slug is empty and the hash separates it.

vectors.name: unicode_emoji
vectors.note: Astral-plane input: Python iterates code points, JS must iterate the same.

vectors.name: unicode_lookalike
vectors.note: Cyrillic 'a' looks like ASCII 'a' but is a different namespace.

vectors.name: over_length
vectors.note: Slug truncated to 32 characters; the hash still covers all 40.

vectors.name: over_length_distinct
vectors.note: Truncation must not merge two different raw values.

vectors.name: over_length_mixed
vectors.note: A realistic over-length name.

vectors.name: empty
vectors.note: Rejected by raw_deployment_id() at startup; the pure canonicalization is still pinned.

vectors.name: whitespace_only
vectors.note: Also rejected at startup, for the same reason.

vectors.name: slug_empty
vectors.note: Not whitespace, so it is accepted; it slugs to empty and keeps the leading '-'.
